aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware this mode carries substantially higher drawdown risk and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay and rebalancing, which can lead to rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.
